text:
4. 1. 4

Arahantasuttaṃ

1688. Pañcimāni bhikkhave, indriyāni. Katamāni pañca: saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ. Yato ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññāvimuttoti.
